audit_metadata.title: Container Build Verification & Evaluation-Gate Security Audit
audit_metadata.working_tree_status: DIRTY_CONTROLLED_AUDIT (Audit tests, enhanced evaluation gate, and reports added; zero production code or models modified)

workstream_a_container_verification.build_error: ERROR: failed to connect to the docker API at npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine; check if the path is correct and if the daemon is running: open //./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine: The system cannot find the file specified.
unperformed_checks: In-container model loading smoke test inside sealed Linux image
Extraction and pinning of immutable OCI image digest (@sha256:...)

adversarial_tests_passed: Rejection of modified predictions array (even by 1e-12 float delta)
Rejection of modified model artifact hash
Rejection of modified source commit hash
Rejection of modified input manifest hash
Rejection of missing mandatory commitment fields
workstream_b_prediction_commitment_audit.security_limitation: A SHA-256 prediction commitment proves binding to bytes at submission time; it does not prove the operator did not access unblinded labels earlier or that predictions were generated exclusively by approved code. Strong security requires independent key custody and single-shot execution.

workstream_c_single_shot_enforcement_aud.ledger_file_format: JSON array of executed run IDs
workstream_c_single_shot_enforcement_aud.crash_safety_mechanism: Atomic write via temporary file (.ledger_tmp_{pid}_{time}.json) and os.replace()
workstream_c_single_shot_enforcement_aud.corrupted_ledger_behavior: Fails closed with RuntimeError on non-list or invalid JSON

assurance_classifications.duplicate_detection: VERIFIED (Blocks duplicate run ID with RuntimeError)
assurance_classifications.concurrency_safety: VERIFIED (Directory spinlock mutually excludes simultaneous runs)
assurance_classifications.tamper_evidence: PARTIAL (Local file can be deleted or edited by machine admin without detection)
assurance_classifications.cross_machine_replay_resistance: MISSING (Local file is host-bound; copying environment resets ledger)
assurance_classifications.independent_auditability: PARTIAL (Readable locally, requires external ledger for tamper resistance)

workstream_d_authorization_enforcement_a.token_expiration_support: Implemented with ISO 8601 UTC timestamp comparison

assurance_levels.unit_test_level: VERIFIED (Helper rejects missing, invalid, and expired tokens with PermissionError)
assurance_levels.integration_test_level: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED (Evaluation gate module enforces authorization strictly before prediction verification)
assurance_levels.operational_control_level: SPECIFIED_IN_CHECKLIST (Evaluator keeps decryption key in physical/remote custody away from developers)
assurance_levels.generation_entry_point_level: PROTECTED_BY_ABSENCE (v2.2 generator does not exist in repository; generation path cannot be invoked accidentally)

suppressed_sensitive_data: Raw authorization tokens (only 8-char SHA-256 prefix logged)
Row-level prediction errors or False Negative order IDs
workstream_e_log_confidentiality_audit.storage_limitation: Audit logs are local JSONL files; local administrator can modify or delete without cryptographic sealing.

boundary_tests_passed: Strict floor integer rounding across budgets (1%, 2%, 5%, 10%)
Small dataset edge cases (N=10, 5% budget -> C=0; N=19 -> C=0; N=20 -> C=1)
Tied score handling: deterministic sorting by (score DESC, order_date ASC, order_id ASC) strictly obeys budget C
Unconstrained minimum cost ($101,090 at u=0.067633, volume 43.03%) explicitly separated from capacity-constrained policy

remaining_blockers.title: OCI Container Image Digest Build & Pinning
remaining_blockers.description: Docker daemon inactive on local Windows host. Dockerfile.evaluator and requirements-evaluator.lock exist. Image must be compiled on a host with an active OCI daemon to extract the immutable @sha256:... digest.

remaining_blockers.title: Formal Holdout Authorization & Seed Escrow
remaining_blockers.description: Independent Evaluator Checklist must be formally signed off by stakeholders before generating Synthetic Dataset v2.2 and encrypting labels.
